report.summary: The stepped brick massing, flat roofs, pale coping, and cream-trimmed windows form a coherent miniature, but the principal entrance cannot be verified because the orientation map and Street View references are unavailable.

orientation.summary: The actual inventory contains one recessed blue double door on face -v (268°/west). The labeled sheet shows +u/north at upper left, -u/south at upper right, +v/east at lower left, and -v/west at lower right; however, the -v target face is poorly exposed/partly obscured. Without MAP and located SV1–SV4 imagery, there is no source-to-face evidence confirming that west is the real principal-entry side.

issues.problem: Principal-entry orientation is unresolved: only the model inventory supports the -v placement, while the required map and geolocated street views are missing.
issues.fix: Supply the MAP and SV atlas, then compare the visible real entrance directly with the corresponding labeled outward face; relocate the sole principal portal if it does not match.

issues.problem: The recessed blue-accent entrance—the strongest identifying feature—is difficult to read in both the overview and four-face sheet.

scene_review.summary: The stepped single-storey brick footprint, layered flat roofs, pale coping, and varied window groupings give BMO the stronger and more recognizable silhouette. Materials and scale fit the scene, with no conspicuous texture failure or broken massing. However, the characteristic recessed blue entrance is almost impossible to identify in both the aerial scene and labeled sheet; the -v view is obstructed by a large foreground building. The inventory reports one double door, not a duplicated entrance, but its role and side cannot be validated.

orientation.summary: The sole actual blue double door is on the recessed -v face, facing 268° west. That matches the author claim but not verified independent evidence: the prior source-to-face audit explicitly could not confirm the real entrance side. The nearest-road face is -u toward West Main Street, but that fact alone does not prove an entrance there. With the relevant west face obscured and no independent confirmation, principal-entry orientation remains unresolved and needs attention.
